_note: Hallasan content. Stage coordinates are metres: x runs 0..width left to right, z runs -depth/2 (far, into the scene) .. +depth/2 (near the camera). Start positions are [x, z]. The walkable stage is surrounded by a non-walkable ground apron: 'sides' metres on the left, right and near edges, 'far' metres on the far edge (a backdrop ridge stands beyond it). Props: density per 100 m2 of ground (walkable + apron) and a fixed random seed.
